maria_csm: Heads-up — seeing CRM hygiene drift for a set of mid-market accounts. ~12 accounts missing 'last_onboarding_touch' and 'first_value_date'. Renewal risk flags not accurate. Can CS Ops help automate playbook triggers + a reliable health_score property? I can drop sample IDs.

jonathan_cs_ops: Yep — please paste the IDs. Thinking HubSpot workflow + a custom property redwood_health_score (0-100) + webhook to the playbook-runner. We need canonical activation events defined too.

maria_csm: Sample IDs: RW-4512, RW-4530, RW-4589, RW-4620, RW-4699 — I’ll DM the full list. Current manual playbook execution is inconsistent across CSMs.

lena_enablement: We should tie enablement tasks to the score. Proposed weights inline: recency_of_touch 40%, activation_events 30%, support_volume (inverse) 20%, NPS 10%. Quick pseudo-formula: health_score = round(40*recency_score + 30*activation_score + 20*(1 - support_ratio) + 10*nps_score).

ev an_product: If we add a health_reason enum to the API/console we can show the driver(s) causing low score (eg 'no-activation', 'missed-onboarding', 'support-spike'). That helps CSMs prioritize.

ashley_ae: Playbook actions I'd like automated: 1) send onboarding checklist email (templated) 2) create cadence task in CRM 3) auto-schedule a 30min enablement if CSM calendar has an open slot 4) escalate to AE when score < 40 and renewal < 6 months.

cs_ops_bot: Automated scan finished — 12 accounts missing touch dates, 7 would be <50 using the prototype weights. Snippet of the query I ran: 
```sql
SELECT account_id, last_touch, first_value_date
FROM accounts
WHERE last_touch IS NULL AND account_tier = 'mid-market';
```

jonathan_cs_ops: Steps I propose: 1) create custom properties: redwood_health_score (int), redwood_score_breakdown (string), redwood_health_reason (enum) 2) build an automated workflow to recalc scores daily via our calc-service 3) webhook to playbook-runner when thresholds cross 4) data backfill job for missing fields. ETA: small ops sprint ~2 weeks to ship initial automation.

maria_csm: For backfill we can reconstruct last_onboarding_touch from engagement logs and first_value_date from usage events. I'll export sample events and hand off to you.

lena_enablement: I'll author 3 playbook templates + email sequences. Need tokens for {{account_tier}}, {{first_value_date}}, {{cs_owner}}. ETA 5 business days once properties exist.

ashley_ae: Can we add a computed boolean 'at_risk_renewal' that triggers AE alerts? Makes reporting easier.

ev an_product: One more ask: make the scoring transparent. Add a human-readable score_breakdown field or small JSON blob so CSMs can see contributions per signal and we can audit regressions.

jonathan_cs_ops: Agreed. Schema to push: redwood_health_score (int), redwood_score_breakdown (string, JSON), redwood_health_reason (enum). Backfill plan: run one-off backfill then nightly sync. I'll create a deploy runbook for the workflows.

maria_csm: :thumbsup: Owners and rough deadlines: jonathan -> infra + workflows (live by 2025-07-03), lena -> playbooks & templates (ready by 2025-06-30), maria -> event exports + account list (today), ashley -> define AE escalation rules (2025-06-28).

cs_ops_bot: Ticket created: CS-1423 (Automation: health_score + playbook triggers). Assigned to jonathan_cs_ops.

maria_csm: Thanks all — I'll follow up in Asana under CS-1423 with the exported event CSV and full account list. Please flag any blockers in this thread.
